section1.point3: 1.2. Acceptance of the offer – full and unconditional acceptance of the offer.
section1.point4: 1.3. Licensee – a person who has accepted (agreed to conclude an agreement) the offer.
section1.point5: 1.4. License – the right to use the website within the period provided by the Licensor.

section2.listTitle: 2.3. Under this Agreement, the license for the right to use the website includes:
